power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_starti: Spawn me ke ko'i hao Unbreaking II.
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.name: ʻeleʻele
origins.neoorigins.class_blacksmith.desc: ʻO kahi haku hana akamai i ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o nā lako a ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka hoʻoponopono ʻana.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_repair: ʻOi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ka hoʻoponopono ʻana o Anvil a hoʻihoʻi hou i ka lōʻihi.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_forge_: Haʻihaʻi nā lima lima ʻole i ka pōhaku e like me ke koʻi pōhaku.
Lawe i ka hapalua o ka pōʻino mai ke ahi, ka pele, ka pelemaka, a me ke ahi - hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka ʻili.
power.neoorigins.class_blacksmith_starti: Spawn me 4 iron ingots e hoʻomaka i ka forge.
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.name: Kuke
origins.neoorigins.class_cook.descriptio: He loea kulini nona ka meaʻai i hana ʻia i ʻoi aku ka momona a loaʻa iā ia ka bonus XP mai ka puhi ʻana.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.name: ʻAi maikaʻi
power.neoorigins.class_cook_food.descrip: Hāʻawi ka meaʻai āu e hana ai i ka pōloli bonus a me ka saturation.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_iron_stomach: Palekana i ka pololi a me ka nausea.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_seasoned_pal: He 25% ka lōʻihi o ka hopena o ka Potion iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.name: Ka Pahi a Kuke
power.neoorigins.class_cook_knife.descri: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia me ka pahi kaua hao - pono kēlā me kēia kuke i kahi maka maikaʻi.
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.name: Kalepa
origins.neoorigins.class_merchant.descri: He kanaka kalepa maalea, aole i pau ka kalepa ana o ke kamaaina, a loaa ka waiwai laa ole mai ka poe kalepa auwana.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_trades.d: ʻAʻole e pau nā kālepa kamaʻāina iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_rare_loo: Hāʻawi nā mea kālepa auwana iā ʻoe i nā kālepa kamaʻāina master-tier a me kahi manawa i ka waiwai liʻiliʻi.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_starting: Spawn me ka emerald e hua i kāu kālepa mua.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_silver_t: He 15% ka lōʻihi o ka hopena o ka Potion iā ʻoe - mau ka hoʻokipa.
power.neoorigins.class_merchant_lucky_tr: +1 Laki — loaʻa ka pōmaikaʻi i kahi haggler maikaʻi.
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.name: Kahuna
origins.neoorigins.class_cleric.descript: He haumana hemolele me nā mana hoʻohiwahiwa i hoʻonui ʻia a me ka lōʻihi o ka potion.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_enchanting: Hāʻawi nā papa hoʻohiwahiwa i nā mea hoʻohiwahiwa kokoke iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.na: ʻO nā lāʻau i hoʻonui ʻia
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_potions.de: ʻElua mau hopena o ka potion a pau.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_turn_undea: ʻO ka paʻi ʻana i ka undead e waiho iā lākou i nāwaliwali no 4 kekona.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_divine_sig: ʻIke maopopo loa i ke kukui haʻahaʻa - he makana mai luna mai.
power.neoorigins.class_cleric_starting_b: Spawn me kahi puke kākau no nā pule a me nā memo.
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.name: Hepa
origins.neoorigins.class_nitwit.descript: ʻAʻole maikaʻi loa i kekahi mea.I kekahi manawa ʻo ke ala maʻalahi ke ala pololei.
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.name: Fisher
origins.neoorigins.class_fisher.descript: ʻO ke ola ma ka lihi o ka wai - e huki i ka laki mai ke kai, ʻauʻau e like me ke sila, a hoʻomaka me ke koʻokoʻo pōmaikaʻi.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_waters_luc: +1 Laki i loko o ka wai - makemake ke kai iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_swim_speed: + 15% ka wikiwiki o ka neʻe ʻana i ka wai.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_sea_legs.d: Half drow damage - nā māmā i maʻa i ka hohonu.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_starting_r: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia me kahi koʻokoʻo i hoʻokalakupua ʻia me Luck of the Sea I a me Lure I.
power.neoorigins.class_fisher_night_sigh: Loaʻa i ka ʻike pō ʻoiai ma lalo o ka wai.
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.name: Makona
origins.neoorigins.class_mason.descripti: Hāʻawi ka pōhaku i nā lima hoʻomaʻamaʻa - ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o ka uhaʻi ʻana i nā poloka, nā pālima callused e pale i ke kino, a hiki ke loaʻa kahi koho.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_hands: Haʻihaʻi nā lima lima ʻole i ka pōhaku e like me ke koʻi pōhaku.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_strong_grip: +1 mea kaua kūlohelohe mai ke ola o ka hoʻopaʻa ʻia ʻana.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_stone_speed: Wehe i nā poloka 25% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_starting_pi: Spawn me ka Efficiency I pohaku pickaxe.
power.neoorigins.class_mason_block_reach: +1 poloka hoʻokomo ʻana - ʻike ka lima o ka mason i kahi e pau ai ka pā.
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.name: Paladina
origins.neoorigins.class_paladin.descrip: He koa hemolele - ʻaʻole i make ka make ma ka hoʻopā ʻana, ʻaʻole hiki i ka maloʻo ke paʻa, a ʻo ke kukui o ke kukui e hoʻōla i nā ʻeha.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_turn_unde: ʻO ka paʻi ʻana i ka undead e waiho iā lākou i nāwaliwali no 4 kekona.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_holy_armo: +2 mea kaua kūlohelohe - pale ka mālamalama iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_beacon_re: Hoʻoulu hou ʻia i loko o 8 mau poloka o kahi kukui.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_starting_: Spawn me ka pahi kaua hao.
power.neoorigins.class_paladin_effect_im: Immune to Wither - ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻopā iā ʻoe.
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.name: Necromancer
origins.neoorigins.necromancer.descripti: He haku o ka make nāna e kauoha i nā minions undead - nā iwi maloʻo a me nā pana pua e hakakā ma kou ʻaoʻao, akā ua paʻa kou ola ponoʻī iā lākou.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_with: E hoʻokiʻekiʻe i ka iwi ʻili maloʻo
Kāhea i ka iwi maloʻo e kaua no ʻoe.Max 2 i ka manawa hoʻokahi.ʻO ke kumu kūʻai 6 essence.30-kekona hoʻomaha.Lawe ʻoe i 1 pōʻino inā make i ke kaua.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_summon_skel: Kāhea i ka pana pua e kaua no ʻoe.Max 3 i ka manawa hoʻokahi.ʻO ke kumu kūʻai 4 essence.20-kekona hoʻomaha.Lawe ʻoe i 1 pōʻino inā make i ke kaua.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_entity_grou: Hoʻokaʻawale ʻia ma ke ʻano he undead.Hoʻopilikia ʻia e ke Ola koke, hoʻōla ʻia e ka pōʻino koke, pale ʻole i ka lāʻau.Pilikia i ka hahau.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_water_breat: ʻAʻole pono e hanu.Hiki ke ola mau loa ma lalo o ka wai.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_night_visio: Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.necromancer_daylight_da: Lawe i ka pōʻino 1.5 i kēlā me kēia kekona ke ʻike ʻia i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.necromancer_reduced_hea: -3 puʻuwai (-6 max HP).He kino i luku ʻia e ka make kilokilo.
Hoʻemi ʻia ka hoʻōla hou ʻana o ke olakino kūlohelohe i 40% o ka mea maʻamau.
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon
origins.neoorigins.gorgon.description: He mea ʻino ili pōhaku nona ka nānā ʻana i nā maka a haki kona mau lima - akā ʻo ke kaumaha o ka pōhaku e lohi i kēlā me kēia ʻanuʻu.
Hoʻokuʻu i nā ʻenemi kokoke mai me ka Slowness V. Nā kumu kūʻai 3 stamina.15-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.name: Puʻu Pōhaku
power.neoorigins.gorgon_stone_fists.desc: Hāʻawi i 4 pōʻino hou i kēlā me kēia pā.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_granite_hide.des: Kū'ē Kūmau I - hoʻopalupalu ka ʻili pōhaku i kēlā me kēia hopena.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.name: Ponderous
power.neoorigins.gorgon_heavy_frame.desc: Neʻe 20% lohi ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.name: Hoʻohihi nui
power.neoorigins.gorgon_size.description: 15% ka nui ma mua o ka mea pāʻani maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.gorgon_hunger_drain.des: He 50% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o ka hoʻopau ʻana i ka ikaika - ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka mālama ʻana i ke ʻano pōhaku.
origins.neoorigins.automaton.name: ʻOtometi
origins.neoorigins.automaton.description: ʻO kahi hana mīkini ʻaʻole e maloʻo a pōloli paha - akā ua paʻakikī nā lāʻau lapaʻau, ʻo ka hoʻōla maoli ʻana he glacial, a ua kaumaha kēlā me kēia hana.
power.neoorigins.automaton_iron_frame.de: Kūpaʻa Paʻa I — ʻaʻole e ʻeha ka pahu hao paʻa.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.name: Chassis i hoʻopaʻa ʻia
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_drown.desc: ʻAʻole pono e hanu.ʻAʻole hiki ke poho.
power.neoorigins.automaton_no_hunger.des: ʻAʻole loa e pōloli.E holo ana ma kahi kumu mana o loko.
power.neoorigins.automaton_hide_hunger_b: Ua hūnā ʻia ka pā pōloli - ʻaʻole ʻai nā automatons.
Ua hūnā ʻia ka pā ea - ʻaʻole hanu nā automatons.
power.neoorigins.automaton_potion_resist: Ka pale ʻana i ka hana hou ʻana, ke olakino koke, a me ka lāʻau make.Hoʻohana mau nā hopena potion ʻē aʻe.
Hāʻawi nā mea ʻike maka i kūkulu ʻia i ka ʻike ma ka pouli.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.automaton_heavy_chassis: E neʻe 15% lohi - ke kiʻi kaumaha, nā kapuaʻi kaumaha.
Holo ka ho'ōla kūlohelohe ma 25% - kūkulu ʻia e hoʻomanawanui, ʻaʻole hoʻi.
power.neoorigins.automaton_knockback_res: 40% kūʻē kūʻē mai ke kaumaha nui.
origins.neoorigins.kraken.name: Kraken
origins.neoorigins.kraken.description: Hānau ʻia kahi mea ʻaihue hohonu hohonu i loko o ke kai ākea - e luku ana i lalo o ka wai me nā ʻūhiʻu ʻuʻuku, nā kiʻi inika, a kāhea ʻia nā kiaʻi, akā i kahakai, puhi ʻia i ka lā, a maloʻo ma luna o ka ʻili.
power.neoorigins.kraken_tentacle_lash.de: Hoʻopau i kahi pahu aka e makapō a hoʻolohi i nā ʻenemi a pau ma kahi radius 6-poloka.ʻO nā kumu kūʻai 2 essence.6-kekona hoʻomaha.
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.name: Puka Inika
power.neoorigins.kraken_ink_shot.descrip: Hoʻopau i ka ʻīnika koʻikoʻi e hoʻolohi nui i nā ʻenemi ma kahi radius 5-poloka.ʻO nā kumu kūʻai 2 essence.8 kekona hoʻomaha.
Hanu i lalo o ka wai no ka pau ʻole a ʻike pono i ka wai me ka ʻole o ka noe.
